HEAVYSILENT_WHETSTONE.title: Whetstone
HEAVYSILENT_WHETSTONE.description: The first time you [gold]Mill[/gold] each turn, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold].
HEAVYSILENT_WHETSTONE.flavor: A thousand strokes have left their mark.
HEAVYSILENT_JADE_WHETSTONE.title: Jade Whetstone
HEAVYSILENT_JADE_WHETSTONE.description: The first time you [gold]Mill[/gold] each turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to twice the Mill amount.
HEAVYSILENT_JADE_WHETSTONE.flavor: Its quiet luster conceals a perfect edge.
HEAVYSILENT_BREATH_VESSEL.title: Breath Vessel
HEAVYSILENT_BREATH_VESSEL.description: At the start of combat, shuffle {Cards} [gold]Qi+[/gold] into your Draw Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_BREATH_VESSEL.flavor: The lid is open, yet a breath remains within.
HEAVYSILENT_BREATH_CHARM.title: Breath Charm
HEAVYSILENT_BREATH_CHARM.description: The first time you play [gold]Qi[/gold] each turn, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold].
HEAVYSILENT_BREATH_CHARM.flavor: A slip of paper shelters one last breath.
